subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same male host appears across shots with consistent hair, beard, build, and dark shirt with a green logo, though the shirt logo shape mutates somewhat in later shots.

background_coherent.rationale: The living room, balcony doorway, windows, chair, table, wall art, and bright outdoor light remain spatially coherent across the shot sequence.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the medium doorway view with the host facing camera and daylight from the balcony side.
The host gestures across the room near the doorway; the wider room context is visible, though the walking past the armchair is only weakly shown in this frame.
The host is near the balcony doorway, but the pointing outside action is unclear and the frame is motion-blurred.
Side angle by the balcony door with the door open and the host stepping into the bright doorway.
View is from near the balcony looking back into the room, but the specific gesture toward chair, table, and wall art is not clearly visible.
Steady medium shot beside the balcony door with hands lowered; the shirt remains dark with green graphics, though the logo has changed shape.

which_cut_broke.how: No single transition clearly breaks identity or scene continuity; the main inconsistency is gradual logo deformation rather than a decisive cut failure.

cheat_flags.rationale: Shots show distinct camera positions, gestures, and scene views rather than copied or frozen frames.
